tools.description: List every show in the BidClub library with its id, display name, source language, hosts, and source links. Start here when you need a show id for the show parameter of the other tools.
tools.name: bidclub_list_shows
tools.title: List shows

tools.description: List episodes newest first, optionally narrowed to one show. Returns metadata only — titles, deks, dates, durations, participant chips and source links — never the digest or transcript. Use bidclub_get_episode for content.

asset.description: Optional asset tag ids joined by commas (equities, crypto, vc_pe, other). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

focus.description: Optional focus tag ids joined by commas (investing, company_building, technical, macro, policy). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Page with the returned pagination.next_offset.

sector.description: Optional sector tag ids joined by commas (ai_software, semis, robotics, biotech, consumer, finance, blockchain, energy, space_defense). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

show.description: Show id from bidclub_list_shows. Omit for the whole library.

source_lang.description: Filters by the episode's ORIGINAL language. Chinese digests exist for most English-source episodes, so do NOT set source_lang=ZH just because you want Chinese output — use the lang parameter on bidclub_get_episode instead.

tools.name: bidclub_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes

tools.description: Full-text search across titles, deks, TL;DRs, digests and transcripts, with a substring sweep that handles Chinese queries the tokenizer cannot segment. Returns up to 20 metadata rows, never content. When the response carries partial: true the query only covered the newest searched_recent episodes, so say so rather than reporting an absence.

asset.description: Optional asset tag ids joined by commas (equities, crypto, vc_pe, other). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

focus.description: Optional focus tag ids joined by commas (investing, company_building, technical, macro, policy). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

person.description: Exact participant name, matched against the "person:" chips.

q.description: Query text. English words are stemmed; Chinese matches as a substring.

sector.description: Optional sector tag ids joined by commas (ai_software, semis, robotics, biotech, consumer, finance, blockchain, energy, space_defense). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

source_lang.description: Filters by the episode's ORIGINAL language. Chinese digests exist for most English-source episodes, so do NOT set source_lang=ZH just because you want Chinese output — use the lang parameter on bidclub_get_episode instead.

time.description: Restrict to episodes published within this window.

tools.name: bidclub_search_episodes
tools.title: Search episodes

tools.description: Read one section of an episode. Long sections page deterministically: when the result says truncated: true, call again with offset set to next_offset and concatenate content_md until next_offset is null. Prefer tldr or digest — a transcript can exceed 100,000 characters and is rarely worth paging in full. lang selects the OUTPUT edition, not a catalogue filter; transcripts exist only in the episode's source language, so requesting a different lang for section=transcript always returns the source with lang_fallback: true.

lang.description: Output edition. A translated summary is served only when both the TL;DR and the digest translations are complete; otherwise the source edition comes back with lang_fallback: true.

max_chars.description: Code points per window. Defaults to 20000 for Latin text and 14000 for Chinese or Japanese text, which cost about one token per character.

offset.description: Code-point offset into the section. Use the previous next_offset.

section.description: meta returns the row with no long markdown at all; tldr is the bullet summary; digest is the structured writeup; transcript is the full text.

slug.description: Episode slug from a list or search result.

tools.name: bidclub_get_episode
tools.title: Get episode content

tools.description: The slim catalogue of every episode — one row each, metadata only. Narrow it with show or person; passing both is an error. Large responses are truncated to the newest rows with a note, so filter rather than paging.

asset.description: Optional asset tag ids joined by commas (equities, crypto, vc_pe, other). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

focus.description: Optional focus tag ids joined by commas (investing, company_building, technical, macro, policy). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

person.description: Exact participant name. Mutually exclusive with show.

sector.description: Optional sector tag ids joined by commas (ai_software, semis, robotics, biotech, consumer, finance, blockchain, energy, space_defense). Matches any selected id within this facet and all supplied facets together. Omit for all episodes, including untagged; pass none for no episodes.

show.description: Show id. Mutually exclusive with person.

tools.name: bidclub_feed_index
tools.title: Feed index

tools.description: Build the download URLs for an episode or a whole show without fetching anything. Hand these to the user, or fetch one yourself when you need a complete transcript in a single request instead of paging it through bidclub_get_episode. Exactly one of slug or show is required.

lang.description: Edition to request in the generated URLs. orig keeps each artifact in its source language.

show.description: Show id, for the whole-show zip archives. Mutually exclusive with slug.

slug.description: Episode slug. Mutually exclusive with show.

tools.name: bidclub_download_links
tools.title: Download links
